claude.rationale: gap_45=1: A fractional 35% working interest in 32 designated wells (the customer-facing producing asset, T4) was assigned to ArcLight, but "Operatorship did not transfer" — the wells remain "operated by Rex," so the operational processes that produce/deliver hydrocarbons (T5) did not cross the boundary with the asset, a documented product-vs-process split at closing. gap_mitigated=yes because the Participation Agreement's cost-carry mechanism and adjustment/reversion provisions ("to maintain the value (to each party) of the transaction") contractually allocate the shared operating substrate at closing. gap_56=0: since T5 (operatorship) was retained by Rex and did not transfer or get re-engineered, there is no process-transfer that outran an accompanying organization; the filing discloses no transfer of employees/management/organization at all.

gemini.rationale: ArcLight acquired a 35% working interest in 32 designated wells (T4 subset), but Rex retained operatorship of the wells (T5 read-only), creating a structural gap between the asset ownership and its operational processes. This gap is mitigated by the Participation Agreement which governs the cost-funding and operations. No employees or organization transferred, remaining aligned with the retained operations (gap_56 = 0).

openai.rationale: Rex assigned ArcLight a fractional working interest in specifically designated wells, but operatorship remained with Rex, creating a product-versus-process split at closing. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-117866, Form 8-K Item 1.01] That split was contractually absorbed through the Participation Agreement's cost-funding, working-interest adjustment, and retained-operatorship structure. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-117866, Form 8-K Item 1.01] Because the operational processes did not transfer or undergo disclosed re-engineering, the absence of any employee, management, or organizational transfer does not establish a T5-T6 gap. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-117866, Form 8-K Item 1.01]
